Kimchi Jjigae (Kimchi Stew)

A deeply flavorful, spicy Korean staple made with aged kimchi, fatty pork, and silky tofu. Perfect for cold evenings.

  • 2 bowls
  • 10 minutes
  • 30 minutes
  • 40 minutes
  • Medium

Ingredienser

  • Base
  • aged Kimchi : 1 cup (The sourer, the better)
  • pork belly : 150 g (Or shoulder, thinly sliced)
  • firm tofu : ½ block (Sliced into 1cm rectangles)
  • Aromatics & Veggies
  • onion : 1 small (Sliced)
  • green onions : 2 stalks
  • minced garlic : 1 tsp
  • Stew Base (The Sauce)
  • Gochugaru : 1 tbsp (Korean chili flakes)
  • Soy sauce : 1 tsp
  • Sugar : 1 tsp
  • Water : 2 cups (Or anchovy kelp broth)
